import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TensorObjSubstrate
import Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.LocallySurjective

/-!
# Global sections and the relative evaluation map

A section of a module defines a morphism from the structure sheaf. Such a
morphism factors through the pullback--pushforward counit. Local generators
therefore imply that the counit is an epimorphism.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X S : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The module morphism that multiplies a regular function by a global section. -/
noncomputable def homOfGlobalSection (M : X.Modules) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) M :=
  M.unitHomEquiv.symm (PresheafOfModules.sectionsMk
    (fun U => M.val.map (homOfLE le_top).op s)
    (by
      intro U V i
      rw [← M.val.map_comp_apply]
      rfl))

@[simp]
lemma homOfGlobalSection_app (M : X.Modules) (s : Γ(M, ⊤))
    (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    (homOfGlobalSection M s).app U r =
      r • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op s := rfl

@[simp]
lemma homOfGlobalSection_app_top_one (M : X.Modules) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    (homOfGlobalSection M s).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) = s := by
  rw [homOfGlobalSection_app]
  simp

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Every morphism from the structure sheaf factors through relative evaluation. -/
theorem exists_factor_counit_of_unit_hom (f : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules)
    (s : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) M) :
    ∃ t : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
      (pullback f).obj ((pushforward f).obj M),
      t ≫ (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M = s := by
  let e : (pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf := pullbackUnitIso f
  let adj := pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f
  refine ⟨e.inv ≫ (pullback f).map (adj.homEquiv _ _ (e.hom ≫ s)), ?_⟩
  change (e.inv ≫ (pullback f).map (adj.homEquiv _ _ (e.hom ≫ s))) ≫
    adj.counit.app M = s
  have heval := adj.homEquiv_counit
    (g := adj.homEquiv _ _ (e.hom ≫ s))
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at heval
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((congrArg (e.inv ≫ ·) heval.symm).trans (by simp))

/-- A module map surjective on every additive stalk is an epimorphism.
The proof follows the sheaf criterion also used in `MilneLib.Sheaf.Sheaf`. -/
theorem epi_of_surjective_on_stalks {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ x : X, Function.Surjective
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map f.mapPresheaf)) : Epi f := by
  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf
  have hlocal : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (F.map f).hom :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.locally_surjective_iff_surjective_on_stalks _).2 hf
  have : Epi (F.map f) := by
    letI : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (F.map f) := hlocal
    infer_instance
  exact F.epi_of_epi_map this

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Local invertibility of a module map implies invertibility on the stalk. -/
theorem isIso_stalkMap_of_isIso_restrict {M N : X.Modules} (s : M ⟶ N)
    (W : X.Opens) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W)
    [IsIso ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)] :
    IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map s.mapPresheaf) := by
  let e := restrictStalkNatIso W.ι ⟨x, hx⟩
  haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctor W.ι ⋙ toPresheaf W.toScheme ⋙
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (⟨x, hx⟩ : W.toScheme)).map s) := by
    change IsIso (((toPresheaf W.toScheme ⋙
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (⟨x, hx⟩ : W.toScheme)).map
        ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)))
    infer_instance
  have h : IsIso (e.hom.app M ≫
      ((toPresheaf X ⋙ TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        (W.ι ⟨x, hx⟩)).map s)) := by
    exact (congrArg IsIso (e.hom.naturality s)).mp inferInstance
  exact (isIso_comp_left_iff (e.hom.app M) _).mp h

/-- A module isomorphism carries locally generating global sections to locally
generating global sections. -/
theorem locally_generating_unit_hom_of_iso {M N : X.Modules} (e : M ≅ N)
    (hM : ∀ x : X, ∃ (s : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) M)
      (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)) :
    ∀ x : X, ∃ (s : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) N)
      (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s) := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨s, W, hxW, hs⟩ := hM x
  letI := hs
  refine ⟨s ≫ e.hom, W, hxW, ?_⟩
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  infer_instance

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Global sections locally trivializing a module still do so after any
pullback, on the inverse images of their trivializing open sets. -/
theorem locally_generating_unit_hom_pullback {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (M : X.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ x : X, ∃ (s : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) M)
      (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)) :
    ∀ y : Y, ∃ (s : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)
      ((pullback f).obj M)) (V : Y.Opens),
      y ∈ V ∧ IsIso ((restrictFunctor V.ι).map s) := by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨s, W, hyW, hs⟩ := hM (f y)
  letI := hs
  let V : Y.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ W
  let g : V.toScheme ⟶ W.toScheme := f.resLE W V le_rfl
  let e : pullback f ⋙ restrictFunctor V.ι ≅ restrictFunctor W.ι ⋙ pullback g :=
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (pullback f) (restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι) ≪≫
      pullbackComp V.ι f ≪≫
      pullbackCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι f (show V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W from le_rfl)).symm ≪≫
      (pullbackComp g W.ι).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι).symm (pullback g)
  haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctor V.ι).map ((pullback f).map s)) :=
    (NatIso.isIso_map_iff e s).mpr (by
      change IsIso ((pullback g).map ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s))
      infer_instance)
  refine ⟨(pullbackUnitIso f).inv ≫ (pullback f).map s, V, hyW, ?_⟩
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  infer_instance

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- If global sections locally trivialize a module, its relative evaluation is epic. -/
theorem counit_epi_of_locally_generating_unit_hom (f : X ⟶ S) (M : X.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ x : X, ∃ (s : Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) M)
      (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)) :
    Epi ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
  apply epi_of_surjective_on_stalks
  intro x
  obtain ⟨s, W, hxW, hs⟩ := hM x
  letI := hs
  let F : X.Modules ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    toPresheaf X ⋙ TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x
  haveI : IsIso (F.map s) := isIso_stalkMap_of_isIso_restrict s W hxW
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_factor_counit_of_unit_hom f M s
  haveI : Epi (F.map t ≫ F.map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M)) := by
    rw [← F.map_comp, ht]
    infer_instance
  haveI : Epi (F.map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M)) :=
    epi_of_epi (F.map t) _
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective
    (F.map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M))).mp inferInstance

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
